_curation_notes: MVP insert pool: 7 Scryfall art_crops from the bundle's own cards used as wide thesis-grounder panels, with exclude_from_card_page_name set so an art_crop never lands on the same page as its source card (no card-plus-own-art duplication). Two Wizards art_crops carry affinity_card_name to pin the Orzhov eclipsed-sun-signet pair side-by-side: Pitiless Pontiff's art is pinned to Tithe Drinker's page (and vice versa) so the matching cathedral thrones become a visible thesis spine. Per Alex's curatorial pass on drone (BBL002), starting tithe in 'official Wizards art only' mode rather than ripping fan art — keeps storefront safe and the thesis grounded in canonical illustration. DeviantArt thesis-art can be layered in later by dropping image files into this dir and adding entries.

inserts.theme_fit: Pitiless Pontiff official art — Orzhov cleric on throne backed by eclipsed-sun signet, two supplicants chained by coin-lines. The bundle's apparatus-of-extraction headline visual.
Tithe Drinker official art — seated noble with goblet, matching Orzhov signet throne. Pairs with Pitiless Pontiff: same signet, two different masters.
Mortify official art — woman dissolving in a grey-white swirl, bureaucratic unmaking rendered as physics. The bundle's punctuation mark.
Wicked Guardian official art — noble standing, servant kneeling on the stone behind her. Vertical distance as the real structure of the room.
Charity Extractor official art — knight extending collection pan, locked strongbox on the saddle, keys around the neck. The apparatus is portable.
Lawmage's Binding official art — gauntleted authority hands restraining a horned figure with a ring of blue energy. Authority barely in the frame, doing the work.
Secure the Scene official art — Azorius arrest soldier with luminous blue-mesh chains stretching across the sky. The arrest is the mesh of light around the figure.
Tithebearer Giant official art — gold-plated giant carrying a literal gilded coffer through a gothic city. The extraction object made physical.
Malevolent Noble official art — bearded noble pressing through a dark doorway, spectral hands reaching from the shadows. Complicit menace.
Eye Collector official art — crouching faerie with stolen orb, the courier mid-delivery for an unnamed lord.
